titles: Woodstock Community Trust, Inc. & Housing VT
Woodstock Community Trust & Housing Vermont PRD
candidates.legacy_reason: Document 1 identifies the appeal of the Woodstock DRB’s November 3, 2006 decision granting reconsideration and preliminary approval of a 36-unit affordable housing project. Documents 2 and 3 continue and coordinate the same municipal appeals, including Docket No. 126-6-07 Vtec for final approval. The proposed use is 36 residential dwelling units, and the appeals concern permission for those new units at preliminary and final approval stages.

titles: Appeals of Cyril Z. Meadow Institute and Phyllis Meadow (Decision and Order on Motions for Summary Judgment)
candidates.legacy_reason: Municipal land-use appeals are established by the two dockets. The proposal is principally an educational facility; its residential element is a new building for faculty bedrooms, lounges, and a kitchen, with no express dwelling units or house lots, so housing status is not established.

titles: Appeals of Middlebury College & KW Middlebury LLC
Appeals of Middlebury College & KW Middlebury LLC
In re: Appeals of Middlebury College and KW Middlebury, LLC (Decision and Order on Motion for Reconsideration)
In re: Appeals of Middlebury College and KW Middlebury, LLC.
candidates.legacy_reason: The matter is an appeal of municipal Planning Commission land-use decisions. The overall PUD description mentions residential housing on the retained 31-acre parcel, but the appeals and rulings focus on the commercial Phase I (hotel/conference center and office/apartment building) and on PUD master-plan/subdivision/design prerequisites; no specific new or replacement dwelling units or house lots are established as the permission at issue.

titles: Atwood-Hood PRD
candidates.legacy_reason: The challenged decisions are municipal DRB Discretionary Permit approvals for a proposed twelve-unit residential development in Williston. Appellants Atwood and Hood appeal conditions imposed on permission for new residential units, so the appeal concerns municipal permission for residential dwellings.

titles: Appeals of Madden & Winborn
Appeals of Madden & Winborn
candidates.legacy_reason: The Environmental Court decisions review appeals of municipal building permits for three lots in a residential subdivision, and the permits sought authorization for single-family residences; both municipal land-use appeal and residential dwelling permission are established.

candidates.legacy_reason: This matter is an appeal of municipal land-use decisions: ZBA conditional use approvals (#803, #844) and a Planning Commission PUD denial. Housing=yes because the proposal itself contains residential dwellings-a '6-unit Senior Citizen Residence' ruled a 'multiple family dwelling' entitled to conditional use review, and a proposed 6-person dormitory-and these appeals seek permission (conditional use approval #844 and PUD approval) for those residential units; the parties themselves describe 'residential uses (six senior residences and six visitor residences).'

titles: APC Property LLC dba Burlington Bedrooms
candidates.legacy_reason: The document is a decision on motions in APC's appeal of the Shelburne DRB's denial of a conditional use application and its related NOV appeal, so municipal land-use review is involved. The source never states the proposed use is residential dwellings or that the appeal concerns permission for new, replacement, or additional dwelling units; the only use-related clue is an operation/U-Haul contract, so housing scope is unestablished.

titles: Appeal of Marcelino
candidates.legacy_reason: The source shows appeals from municipal ZBA decisions and identifies the proposed use as a single-family house replacing a mobile home, with the variance/permit dispute concerning the dwelling's authorized location.

titles: Appeal of Rowley
candidates.legacy_reason: The Rowleys appealed DRB denials of municipal zoning approvals: conditional use boundary relocation and a septic-system setback variance. The proposal includes new residential house sites on Lots 2 and 3 and two residential lots, and the approvals at issue are authorizations/conditions for that residential development.

titles: Appeal of Cowan
Town of Richmond v Cowan
candidates.legacy_reason: Review flagged the scope decision: The triage's municipal_appeal/housing classification is correct for Cowan's permit and floodplain appeals, but the candidate separately records Docket No. 102-5-02 Vtec. That docket is an independent Town enforcement action over the retaining wall, not an appeal of a municipal land-use decision; the record shows Cowan did not appeal the notice of violation. Under the scope contract, independent municipal enforcement should not be treated as a municipal housing appeal record.

titles: Benoit Conversion Application - Decision on Motion
City of St. Albans v Hayford - Decision on Motion
candidates.legacy_reason: Docket 148-8-04 Vtec is an appeal of a Development Review Board decision denying approval to convert the rear building to residential use, and the enforcement matters (126-7-04, 161-9-03) and 143-7-08 reopening concern authorization to use the rear building and fifth main-building apartment as residential dwelling units. The proposal is residential and seeks permission for additional/after-the-fact authorized dwelling units (the sixth rear unit and the fifth main-building unit), so housing is established.

titles: In re: Appeals of Christopher Denio
candidates.legacy_reason: Document is an appeal of two ZBA decisions: denial of an as-built amendment to a camp permit and a notice of violation for the same Bennington property. The building is used as a secondary residence, but the zoning permission at issue is for a private recreational camp, so whether the appeal seeks authorization for a new or additional dwelling unit is unclear.

titles: In re: Appeal of Green Mountain Habitat for Humanity and In re: Appeal of Blair and Devlin (Decision and Order on Motions for Summary Judgment)
candidates.legacy_reason: The challenged decision is a municipal Development Review Board ruling on a zoning permit application. The proposed use is a new single-family dwelling on a vacant undersized lot, so the appeal concerns permission for a new dwelling unit. Merger and variance issues go to whether that new-home permission stands.

titles: Tenney Notices of Violation
Tenney Notices of Violation
candidates.legacy_reason: Doc 1 is a direct appeal of a Town of Lincoln Zoning Board of Adjustment decision denying a zoning permit for a replacement mobile home (single-family dwelling) on the site of a preexisting residence, so the challenged municipal decision concerns permission for a replacement dwelling. Docs 2-3 are the same property/dispute, coordinated NOV appeals/enforcement, retaining the underlying identity. Residential use (mobile home/dwelling) and replacement permission are both established by the source.

titles: Beebe 9-Lot Subdivision
candidates.legacy_reason: Both documents are appeals of municipal Planning Commission subdivision/site-plan decisions for Beebe's Highgate property; the proposed use is creation of residential building lots (existing Beebe residence on Lot #4 plus eight new house lots) in the nine-lot subdivision.

titles: Appeals of Garen
Appeal of Garen (Plat Approval)
candidates.legacy_reason: All three documents concern the same consolidated Environmental Court appeals of municipal DRB plat approvals for a proposed eight-unit PRD. The municipal decision challenged is the Burlington DRB's grant of preliminary (218-9-00 Vtec) and final (42-3-01 Vtec) plat approval. The proposed use is residential dwellings (four single-family houses and two duplexes), so permission for new dwelling units is at stake.

titles: Appeal of Bergeron
candidates.legacy_reason: The decision concerns municipal review of a notice of violation and a conditional-use denial for seasonal-to-year-round occupancy of an existing single-family dwelling. That is a residential conversion requiring additional legal authorization, so it qualifies as housing.

titles: Appeal of LaBounty Enterprises, Inc.
candidates.legacy_reason: Source identifies consolidated appeals of DRB zoning permit denials for proposed dwellings on two lots; the dispute concerns permission to build new residential dwellings.

titles: Ploof & Loney ZBA Application
candidates.legacy_reason: The appeal challenges municipal ZBA decisions denying a permit to replace the Ploofs’ existing RV with a larger RV and denying their appeal of a side-yard setback notice of violation. The current and proposed RVs function as a seasonal dwelling with residential facilities, and the appeal concerns permission for that replacement dwelling use.

titles: Nowicki Building Permit
In re Appeal of Nowicki Building Permit and Appeal of Nowicki NOV Appeal
candidates.legacy_reason: Doc 1 is an Environmental Court decision on Developer Nowicki's appeal of a Norwich DRB denial of an after-the-fact zoning permit to build a single-family dwelling at 84 Elm Street, plus related enforcement and NOV dockets; doc 2 is the Supreme Court's further review (2007 VT 76) of the same matter. The challenged decision is municipal (DRB permit denial) and the permission at stake is authorization of a residential dwelling unit, so both scope questions are established.
